content.title: ‘The White Lotus’ Adds Vincent Cassel, Corentin Fila & Nadia Tereszkiewicz To Season 4 Cast
content.text: Skip to main content ‘The White Lotus’ Adds Vincent Cassel, Corentin Fila & Nadia Tereszkiewicz To Season 4 Cast (L-R) Vincent Cassel, Corentin Fila and Nadia Tereszkiewicz Arno Lam/India Lange/Dantstudio hk EXCLUSIVE: Meet the locals! French actors Vincent Cassel (Ocean’s movies, Jason Bourne), Corentin Fila (Being 17, Escort Boys) and Nadia Tereszkiewicz (Forever Young, Heads or Tails) have been cast in the upcoming fourth season of Mike White’s Emmy-winning HBO series The White Lotus.Filming in France, the new installment once again will follow a group of White Lotus hotel guests and employees over the span of a week. Related Stories Cassel — in his return to HBO after his role on Westworld — Fila and Tereszkiewicz are likely to play employees or other locals, following the footsteps of such previous standouts as Murray Bartlett and Natasha Rothwell (Season 1), Sabrina Impacciatore (Season 2) and Lisa (Season 3). Watch on Deadline 1/1 Skip Ad Continue watchingafter the adVisit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGE The trio joins previously announced Season 4 cast members Sandra Bernhard, Helena Bonham Carter, Steve Coogan, Caleb Jonte Edwards, Ari Graynor, Marissa Long, Alexander Ludwig, Chris Messina, AJ Michalka as well as Dylan Ennis, who could also possibly play a Frenchman as a London-based actor of French-Jamaican heritage. Casting is ongoing. Written and directed by series creator White, Season 4 is executive produced by White, David Bernad and Mark Kamine. This is a rare TV series role for veteran film actor Cassel, a César Award winner for Mesrine. He previously did Westworld, Apple TV’s Liaison and Netflix’s Fiasco. Cassel is repped by Laurent Gregoire at Agence Adequat and Range. Fila is repped by Emmanuelle Ramade at Adequat Agency. Tereszkiewicz is repped by Laura Meerson at Adequat Agency and Claire Maroussas at Independent Talent Group.
